units.source_text: “噢，真美啊！”太吉郎在门前伫立，欣赏着胡枝子白花，看得都入迷了。

en.t: Oh, how beautiful! Taikichiro stood before the gate, gazing at the white bush clover blossoms until he was completely absorbed.

units.source_text: 他原先是为了买房才来看这所房子的，但现在他已经失去了这份心情。

en.t: He had originally come to look at this house because he meant to buy it, but now that feeling had already left him.

units.source_text: 因为他发现贴邻的那间稍大的房子，已经做了饭馆兼旅馆。

en.t: For he had noticed that the slightly larger house right next door had already been turned into a restaurant and inn.
